notes.title: 🏯 Fire weapons and status effects

Fire arrows will burn enemies from range, while the fire aura will incinerate any enemies that get too close. notes.title: 🏯 Creep infestation
notes.notes:
[h1]Creep infestation[/h1]
A demonic creep infestation is spreading across Japan. It has already metastasized to multiple locations on Shikoku island. Demons are emerging from the creep's hives and tunnels. Fight back, assault the creep cluster, and defeat its heart before the creep swallows all.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44599528/b31dabdacf70102bc5dd1a401d2792ca81002b10.png[/img]

[h3]Creep heart[/h3]
The creep heart at the center of a cluster sustains the creep. Creep, hives, and tunnels will regenerate until the heart is destroyed. Destroying the heart permanently cleanses the creep cluster from the island.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44599528/bd3073193f2775a741551997066019d36473e627.png[/img]

[h3]Weapon masteries[/h3]
Players can now reach mastery in handling a weapon after reaching a high level with it. Masteries modify the properties of weapons and allow them to be further upgraded.
[list]
[*] Katana Slash mastery reduces enemy armor with each hit, making enemies more vulnerable to all attacks.
[*] Hankyu Shot mastery shoots two arrows at the same time.
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44599528/54527dbfee69a5e3be75584ee8e4f20f96a18db1.png[/img]

[h3]Boss attacks[/h3]
[list]
[*] The boss at 12 minutes now fires a cone of ground spikes.
[*] the boss at 15 minutes now fires a sequence of ground spikes tracking the player.
[/list]

[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed enemy spawning budget to include enemies of previous waves.
[*] Fixed enemy spawn interval for waves with multiple types of enemies.
[*] Fixed spawning too many swarms at the same time at minute 13 and minute 20.
[*] Fixed [b]B[/b] button opening pause menu while playing.
[*] Fixed player level up visual effect not following player.
[*] Fixed outrunning the player's position.
[*] Fixed shuriken glaives being unlocked by default.
[*] Fixed walking over barrels to break them.
[/list]

[h3]Improvements and changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Increased astral damage & cooldown (5% -> 10%)
[*] Replaced damage numbers font for improved readability.
[*] Wider dash attack on bosses.
[*] Boss dash attack keeps aiming at the player.
[*] Bosses attack other players in multiplayer mode when their target dies.
[*] Prevent aggroing enemies from other players by walking by.
[*] Removed astral katana slash skill limit upgrade.
[*] Improved waving animations on flags and cloth.
[*] Most enemies now scale in instead of using smoke bombs.
[*] Improved player arrow outline on minimap.
[*] Rebalanced audio levels.
[*] Rebalanced audio distance scaling.
[*] Level-up chests spawn a bit further away from player.
[*] Moved first time spawn points to smaller villages.
[/list]

notes.title: 🏯 Rolling boulder
notes.notes:
[h3]Rolling boulder[/h3]
It's time to bring heavy machinery and steamroll demons. The rolling boulder might not attack very often, but when it does, it hits hard.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44599528/f5e0113d443815863bceedf15be050ccd4043154.png[/img]
[h3]Checkpoints[/h3]
Campfires are back! They save your progress and spawn point. In your next run you start from the campfire you activated most recently, allowing you to gradually explore the entire map. We've added a tooltip that pops up when you activate a campfire.
[h3]Gongs & gates[/h3]
Gongs and torii are back and are finally working as intended. Once activated, you'll be faced with a tough boss and additional mobs. A reward awaits for those who can defeat the boss. We've added a tooltip here as well.
[h3]Bug fixes and Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Improved visibility of boss attack telegraphing 
[*] Campfires no longer reset during a run
[*] Gongs and gates no longer reset during a run
[/list]

notes.title: 🏯 Spring cleaning
notes.notes:
[h3]Your feedback 📢[/h3]
We've made some changes based on your feedback. Most importantly, we've removed [i]Tutorial Mode[/i] entirely and replaced it with a choice between upgrade [i]cards[/i] and upgrade [i]chests[/i]. Most of you prefer cards, so we made that the default. 📢

We've also removed some confusing parts of the game that weren't fully implemented yet:
[list]
[*] Removed difficulty selection 📢
[*] Removed gong trigger 📢
[*] Removed campfire trigger 📢
[*] Removed vendors 📢
[/list]We're grateful for every bit of feedback that we receive. Thank you for helping us making the game better!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44599528/8af4fae4bd282ad7115630dc045912d376e9edb3.png[/img]

[h3]Fixes and changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Minimap more detailed
[*] Minimap zoom buttons now bound to RB/LB
[*] Improved blizzard and meteor descriptions
[*] Attack damage renamed to damage
[*] Attack speed renamed to cooldown
[*] Cooldown icon now blue
[*] Added space key binding to pick choice cards
[*] Fixed picking choice cards while menu is open
[*] Fixed choice cards losing focus when opening and closing menu
[*] Disabled player controls when menu is open
[/list]

notes.title: 🏯 Minimap, more boss fights and weapons
notes.notes:
[h3]Minimap[/h3]
We've been working on adding a minimap that will not only display the geography of any explored area, but also indicate the location of unopened chests, bosses, gongs and torii gates, merchants and your fallen allies. 

Zoom in and out to see what areas of the map are yet to be explored! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44599528/6662c9a5222324d59fb09ddbbc48be0d81ef07b1.png[/img]

[h3]Weapons[/h3]
Two new weapons come with this update, Meteor and Blizzard. Call upon nature's wrath and shower enemies with fire and ice, burning them to crisp or freezing them in place.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44599528/806b88ade5327e2a1ee7b5a28185605dfec167f8.png[/img]

[h3]Boss Behaviours[/h3]
Two additional boss behaviours have been added, one casting multiple small ranged attacks, and another that will test what you have learned in previous boss fights, with an added twist.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44599528/a77574a3d75e27e675bed1dfd9dc0b83fd49a355.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Added boss charging visual effect
[*] Improved telegraphing and damage visuals of bosses
[*] Fixed charge boss sometimes not charging when the player gets close to the boss
[*] Fixed charge boss sometimes teleporting to the opposite side of the screen mid charge
[*] Fixed boss telegraph progress and damage timings
[*] Fixed bosses sometimes not spawning

notes.title: 🏯 Boss fights, spear, and halberd
notes.notes:
[h3]Boss fights[/h3]
We've been working on boss fights behind the scenes. This update contains the first two behaviors our bosses can have, melee area attacks and charge attacks. Of course all boss attacks are clearly telegraphed, giving you time to run to safety.

We're always looking for additional behaviors. Let us know in the comments if there is something you would like us to add.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44599528/00fe61efc5295ce5fd4203813a33ff999378a507.png[/img]

[h3]Weapons[/h3]
This update also brings two additional melee weapons for the samurai. No samurai game would be complete without katana, yari, and naginata.
[list]
[*] Spear thrust: a long range melee attack that can reach half-way across the screen.
[*] Halberd slam: slams the ground to create a huge damage area, pushing enemies outward.
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44599528/2bbffaeca007ad2e6cd238226f8262d01d8d979c.png[/img]

[h3]Bug fixes and improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added Steam Timeline integration.
[*] Star pickup now gives bonus attack speed, move speed, armor, or loot range for a limited amount of time. 📢
[*] Added difficulty selection. We're not sure whether to keep it or not. Let us know what you think!
[*] Winning the run on difficulty 1 & 2 is possible.
[*] Fixed chests spawning with a delay. 📢
[*] Fixed quitting the run while choice cards are showing. 📢
[*] Improved path-finding.
[*] Reduced katana slash damage. (10 → 5)
[*] Reduced katana slash damage upgrade. (6 → 3)
[/list]
Items marked 📢 are based on your suggestions. Thank you so much for your feedback!

notes.title: 🏯 Lightning balance
notes.notes:
As many of you have noticed, our lightning character Raijin had some extremely overpowered attacks, especially the lightning aura. Thank you all for alerting us via the in-game feedback form and on our forums.

The lightning aura and lightning ball were not supposed to ship. What you saw was the raw form we implement new weapons in before we balance them to the rest of the game. Sorry to everyone who had a bad play experience because of this!

At the same time, it was actually good that this happened. We practice Open Development, creating our games in public. You have access to all our builds, mistakes, and failures. You see us slip, fall, and get up again.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44599528/b2e6ec6888d03df587fddf4201c8ac581d4d34eb.png[/img]

Major parts of the game are still missing, and the existing features are a work in progress. We are ashamed to show the game before it is polished, but it is crucial to do so anyway. Only through continuous iteration based on your feedback can we be confident that the game will eventually be good. Your feedback determines [url=https://tasks.onigiri.games]our priorities[/url] and shapes the future of this game.

[h1]Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed lightning aura balance
[*] Fixed lightning ball balance
[*] Fixed chain lightning visuals
[*] Fixed enemies flipping left after each hop
[*] Fixed micro-stutters in entity movement
[*] Fixed newly spawned enemies sometimes running away from the player
[*] Shuriken Fan renamed to Shuriken Star
[/list]

Last week we shipped tutorial mode for single player sessions. Now it also works in multiplayer sessions. Plus, you can turn it on/off in the astral plane. ✨

notes.title: 🏯 Tutorial mode
notes.notes:
The most common feedback we've received from you, our players, is that upgrade choices are difficult to understand. Today we have good news for you. 😊

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44778207/011c2508d6780d652c9e48768d5a5d169b32f724.png[/img]

We have upgrade choice cards now, telling you what each upgrade does. The game pauses until you make your choice. We're calling this tutorial mode.

Tutorial mode is only available when playing solo. In multiplayer mode we keep spawning the upgrades as chests into the world to keep the flow of the game going.

Let us know in the comments below what you think about tutorial mode! ❤️

notes.title: 🏯 Weapons, weapons, weapons!
notes.notes:
[h1]Weapons[/h1]
We've completely overhauled the weapon system. You can now hold and upgrade up to four weapons at any time and find the combination that works best for you. 🏹

We've also added new weapons, including
[list]
[*] Kunai: Throwing knifes that fly in the movement direction.
[*] Hankyu Shot: A smaller bow that can fire arrows faster.
[*] Shuriken Ring: Throws shuriken that orbit around you.
[/list]
Unpicked weapon chests now act as a soft ban on that weapon. If you don't like a weapon, leave its chests on the ground and it won't appear again in the run.

[h1]Visuals[/h1]
In some locations there now is a thin layer of fog on the ground. Just like the water, the fog reacts to your movement and your weapons.

The player character now automatically faces the nearest enemy. This aligns better with weapons that automatically target the nearest enemy, like the katana slash and the hankyu shot. You can still manually override the aim direction using the right stick on a gamepad.

There are many more visual improvements, too numerous to call out. Let us know in the comments which ones you notice immediately.

[h1]Regressions[/h1]
We broke a bunch of things in the process of overhauling the weapon system and we had the tough choice to make whether to delay the update until everything is fixed, ship broken features, or cut those features entirely and ship without them.

Our main priority is iteration time, so delaying the update is not an option. We want to get the new weapons into your hands as soon as possible and hear your feedback. After all, this is a playtest. So let's test things!

Shipping broken features also doesn't serve us. Broken stuff is annoying to all players and distracts from the features that we want to hear feedback about. We already know its broken.

Therefore we're shipping an update this time that has fewer features than the previous version. Most importantly there are no permanent upgrades anymore. The astral talent tree is gone. 😮

Of course it won't be gone forever. We're obsessing over permanent upgrades as much as anyone. Stay tuned for future updates!
